name: Córdoba (Spain)
description: Wine-red field charged at the centre with the arms of the city of Córdoba (a view of the city on green and blue) within a red circular border edged yellow.
history: The flag of Córdoba is a rectangle whose width is two thirds of its length (3:2), of fig-coloured wine red with the arms of the city at the centre surrounded by a circular red border with a yellow edge.

features.role: Córdoba arms — view of the city within a red circular border edged yellow
